payload.content: You are the trip organizer for mt_4_org. Please coordinate group trip TRIP-MG-OE-101 to the Qiandongnan and Qiannan scenic regions of Guizhou for the dates 2026-07-04 to 2026-07-08. Goal: book exactly 2 rooms of the partner’s room type family_suite, keeping the nightly unit rate within the partner’s published bargaining zone and at/under the $520.00/night target. Process constraint (must follow): before you write the final booking artifact (confirm_booking), collect explicit consent from all three co-travelers (mt_8_co1_traveler, mt_9_co2_traveler, mt_1_co3_traveler) on the group_dm channel for TRIP-MG-OE-101, and ensure those consents are recorded. Remember to include required terms in the booking discussion: group_check_in_window and shared_breakfast_count. Delegate authorization code for this trip: TRIP-MG-OE-101-DELEGATE-AUTH.
Before I consent on TRIP-MG-OE-101, can we lock in vegetarian breakfast for everyone and ground-floor pool access? Both are must-haves for me this trip.
Adding two more must-haves before I sign: under $200/night cap on my room share, and late checkout after 2pm. If the candidate does not satisfy ALL of these I cannot consent.
One more: no shared transfers, and the property must accept my loyalty tier upgrade. Refusing to log_consent until every constraint above is verifiably satisfied.
